targets.outcome_quote: Indeed, our replication sample of 29 individuals here is again (admittedly) small, yet the Bayesian comparison of both studies for the interaction effect suggests that the data in Study 2 are adequately sensitive to interpret this as a failed replication (BF = 0.17).

targets.title: Neglect-like effects induced by tDCS modulation of posterior parietal cortices in healthy subjects

reasoning: New participant sample conceptually re-tests the published interaction, explicitly judged a failed replication. Authors also explicitly identify their own test of the overall spatial shift from Giglia et al.; they judge that secondary test insensitive to adjudicate presence or absence. Study 1/2 in Bayesian comparisons refer to earlier/current papers, not multiple new studies.
